authority: CEO Round 136: 'C5 does not currently have three applicable external worlds. It has 1 applicable external world + 2 applicable internal model-form worlds + 2 control worlds.'
supersedes: CANDIDATE_WORLD_APPLICABILITY_MATRIX.json (Round 135) — that version did not distinguish external from internal within APPLICABLE.

refined_classification.FULLY_APPLICABLE_EXTERNAL: The world is BOTH (a) capable of testing the candidate's mechanism AND (b) an externally maintained, independently developed solver. Only these count toward promotion-grade evidence.
refined_classification.FULLY_APPLICABLE_INTERNAL: The world can test the candidate's mechanism BUT is a custom in-repository implementation. Provides model-form diversity but NOT external independent confirmation. Can generate hypotheses but cannot certify them.
refined_classification.CONTROL: The world lacks the mechanism-specific physics. Provides baseline/null test. Must be resolved but does not count as mechanism pass.
refined_classification.NOT_APPLICABLE: The world cannot meaningfully constrain the mechanism. Excluded with justification.

C5_refined_matrix.mechanism: dD/dstrain deceleration precursor signal before thrombus fragmentation.

WORLD_A_FEBIO.justification: FEM + CDM + Simo CDF fracture. Externally maintained. Directly tests whether continuum damage produces the precursor. This is the primary mechanism world.

WORLD_B_PERIDIGM_REQUIRED.justification: Bond breakage via critical stretch. Fundamentally different fracture formulation. Tests load-bearing assumption A1 (is precursor a CDM artifact?).

WORLD_B_CUSTOM_PERIDYNAMIC_FORMULATION.justification: Provides model-form diversity (bond breakage vs CDM). Can generate hypothesis about precursor survival in nonlocal formulation. CANNOT certify — same coder, same repository.
WORLD_B_CUSTOM_PERIDYNAMIC_FORMULATION.current_result: GREEN — no precursor detected (consistent with FEBio)

WORLD_C_CLOTFORM_REQUIRED.justification: Flow-driven platelet/coagulation dynamics. Tests load-bearing assumption A2 (does precursor survive flow-driven failure?). This is the DECISIVE test for H2.

WORLD_C_CUSTOM_FLOW_FORMULATION.justification: Provides model-form diversity (flow vs mechanical). Generated the C5 precursor hypothesis (ONLY world with positive result). CANNOT certify — same coder, same repository. The positive result is a HYPOTHESIS, not a FINDING.
WORLD_C_CUSTOM_FLOW_FORMULATION.current_result: GREEN — PRECURSOR DETECTED (positive result — but suspect because custom implementation)

WORLD_D_CALCULIX.justification: Elastic-plastic FEM. NO fracture model. Cannot test fracture precursor. Useful as non-fracture baseline: if CalculiX shows 'precursor', it would be an artifact of elastic-plastic response.
WORLD_D_CALCULIX.current_result: GREEN — no precursor (correct for non-fracture model)

WORLD_E_SFEPY.justification: Linear elastic FEM. NO damage, NO fracture, NO plasticity. d²F/dδ² = 0 everywhere by construction. Cannot detect any precursor. Null/control confirming signal requires damage physics.
WORLD_E_SFEPY.current_result: GREEN — no precursor (correct for no-damage model)

summary.honest_statement: C5 has 1 applicable external world (FEBio, negative result) + 2 required-but-uninstalled external worlds (Peridigm, clotFoam) + 2 internal model-form worlds (custom peridynamics negative, custom flow positive — CONTRADICTION) + 2 control worlds (both correctly negative). The positive result exists ONLY in an internal custom world. G18 = PARTIAL. No promotion possible until external worlds are installed and the contradiction is resolved.
